bibliography.title: Emulsion templated scaffolds with tunable mechanical properties for bone tissue engineering
bibliography.authors: Owen R, Sherborne C, Paterson T, Green NH, Reilly GC, Claeyssens F.
bibliography.journal: Journal of the Mechanical Behavior of Biomedical Materials
bibliography.publication_type: Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't; research-article; Journal Article

study.research_problem: Bulk PolyHIPEs provide interconnected microporosity but limit plasma and cell penetration with thickness, whereas additive manufacturing can create macropores yet needs a material with tunable mechanics and cell-compatible surfaces.
study.exact_gap: The study asks whether emulsion-templated EHA/IBOA PolyHIPE mechanics can be independently tuned from a microstereolithographic woodpile macroarchitecture and whether selected hierarchical scaffolds support mesenchymal progenitor growth and early osteogenic differentiation (S002:C01-S002:C05).
study.objective_or_hypothesis: Map composition/nominal-porosity effects on tensile properties, fabricate three compositionally distinct four-layer woodpile scaffolds, modify their hydrophobic surfaces, and test cell attachment, proliferation, penetration, and ALP response (S001:C01; S002:C04-S002:C05).
study.study_design: A 5 x 4 material screen spanning EHA/IBOA ratio and nominal internal-phase fraction, tensile testing and SEM degree-of-openness analysis, followed by fabrication of three P80 woodpile scaffold materials, two plasma treatments, two media conditions, and in-vitro cell assays/imaging (S004:C01-S015:C01).
study.sample_or_model: Twenty PolyHIPE sheet compositions; three four-layer woodpile scaffold compositions with approximately 350 micrometer fibers and 650 micrometer spacing; hES-derived mesenchymal progenitor cells over 1-15 days (S004:C01-S020:C01).
comparators: Five EHA/IBOA ratios across four nominal porosities
Dry versus one-hour PBS-soaked tensile material for selected compositions
Untreated versus air-plasma versus acrylic-acid-deposited surfaces
Three scaffold compositions at nominal P80
Osteogenic induction medium with dexamethasone versus supplemented medium without it
No nonporous-strut woodpile or established bone-scaffold comparator
method_spine: Define a composition x nominal-porosity material design space.
Measure tensile modulus, UTS, failure strain, and SEM-derived openness.
Select three materials and tune process conditions to fabricate comparable macro-woodpiles.
Apply and compare surface treatments required for cell attachment.
Measure metabolic activity, DNA-normalized ALP, and cell distribution/penetration.
Interpret mechanics at the tested material/specimen scale and biology at the in-vitro early-marker scale.

verification: Ten tensile specimens per composition, repeated batches/stress-strain concordance, dry/wet checks, and SEM confirm reproducible material trends and hierarchical morphology (S015:C01-S019:C01).
Degree of openness is estimated from ten voids in one SEM image per composition, which is a limited 2D sampling method rather than full 3D porosity verification (S007:C01-S007:C02; S015:C01).
calibration: Write speed and HIPE volume were tuned separately for each selected composition to achieve similar scaffold macrostructure; this is process calibration and must be disclosed when attributing biological differences to material composition (S008:C02).
validation: Cell metabolic activity, confocal/two-photon imaging, and ALP show in-vitro compatibility and early differentiation signals; they do not validate load-bearing bone regeneration or vascularization (S020:C01-S022:C01).
The scaffold itself was not mechanically tested in compression/fatigue and no animal defect model was used.
sensitivity: Composition and nominal porosity are varied systematically for tensile behavior; surface treatment and osteogenic media are varied for cell outcomes (S004:C01-S022:C01).
Scaffold macrogeometry, degradation, pore-size distribution, plasma penetration, seeding method, dynamic culture, and compressive loading were not varied.
application_prediction: Filling a large bone defect, supporting load, enabling vascularization, and serving as a synthetic graft are proposed applications that remain untested (S002:C04; S023:C01; S024:C01).

primary_outcomes: Across twenty sheet compositions, tensile modulus ranged about 0.36-63.01 MPa, UTS 0.11-2.03 MPa, and failure strain 2.60-21.86%; monomer ratio influenced mechanics more strongly than nominal porosity (S001:C01; S017:C01-S017:C02; S023:C01-S023:C03).

Higher nominal porosity increased SEM-derived openness, while composition produced limited openness differences at a given porosity; this supports partial decoupling of chemistry/mechanics from pore openness (S018:C01).

Three P80 materials were fabricated as four-layer woodpiles with macrospaces around 300-650 micrometers and microporous fibers; process settings were composition-specific (S008:C01-S008:C02; S019:C01; S023:C03-S023:C05).

Untreated hydrophobic scaffolds did not support attachment/growth; both plasma treatments improved metabolic activity, with EHA-containing scaffolds generally supporting more activity than the stiffest EHA0 scaffold (S020:C01; S023:C05-S023:C07).

DNA-normalized ALP rose in dexamethasone-containing medium, and only the stiffest EHA0 plus acrylic-acid surface was higher than all other groups at day 15; neither stiffness nor coating alone produced the same effect (S022:C01; S023:C08-S023:C10).

Two-photon imaging showed cells/nuclei/processes within microporous fibers, but imaging was performed on selected high-proliferation scaffolds and no nonporous-fiber control was tested (S014:C01-S014:C02; S021:C01).
study.highest_evidence_level_reached: Material-level tensile design map plus short-term in-vitro scaffold cell/ALP evidence; no scaffold-level load-bearing, degradation, vascularization, animal, or clinical validation.

argument_map.central_claim: EHA/IBOA ratio and nominal porosity provide a tunable PolyHIPE material space that can be fabricated into hierarchical woodpiles and, after plasma treatment, support in-vitro cell growth and an interaction-dependent early ALP signal; this establishes a platform, not a bone-regenerating or load-bearing scaffold.
data: Twenty-composition tensile/openness screen with replicate mechanical tests (S004:C01-S007:C02; S017:C01-S018:C01).
Three selected woodpile materials, surface treatments, metabolic/DNA/ALP assays, and confocal/two-photon imaging (S008:C01-S014:C02; S019:C01-S022:C01).
argument_map.warrant: A broad material design map plus controlled architecture and early cell evidence justifies further scaffold development, but application claims require structural-scale mechanics, transport/degradation, and in-vivo tissue evidence.
backing: The discussion explicitly distinguishes micro- and macropore roles and recognizes that the ALP effect depends on surface chemistry plus stiffness rather than stiffness alone (S023:C04-S023:C10).
argument_map.qualifier: Short-term in-vitro platform evidence for selected compositions and processing conditions.
rebuttals_or_boundaries: Sheet tensile properties describe the polymer/strut material, not the compression, bending, shear, fatigue, or permeability of the woodpile scaffold (S023:C01).
Nominal internal-phase fraction and 2D degree of openness are not complete as-built 3D porosity/pore-throat characterization.
Process parameters were adjusted by composition, so material and manufacturing histories are not perfectly isolated (S008:C02).
Cell imaging selected high-proliferation samples and lacks nonporous-fiber controls; causal benefit of microporous struts is inferred (S014:C01; S023:C07-S023:C08).
ALP is an early marker under dexamethasone, not mineralized tissue or osteoinduction; the no-dexamethasone condition did not show a general scaffold-induced effect (S022:C01).
No degradation, leachables, mechanical conditioning, vascularization, animal bone formation, or clinical use was tested.

measured: Material tensile properties, limited SEM openness, macrogeometry, metabolic activity, dsDNA, ALP, and selected cell distribution/penetration (S006:C01-S022:C01).
predicted: Surface plots interpolate the composition/nominal-porosity design space; they are descriptive predictions within the measured range, not validated scaffold performance models (S017:C01; S023:C01).
inferred: Microporous fibers are inferred to improve diffusion, continuous tissue formation, and osteogenic behavior without a nonporous-fiber comparator (S023:C07-S023:C08).
The EHA0-pdAAc ALP interaction is attributed to ligand availability enabling stiffness sensing, a plausible but untested mechanism (S023:C09-S023:C10).
Macrovoid sizes are inferred to permit vascularization based on literature thresholds, not measured vessel growth (S002:C04; S023:C05).
recommended: Measure as-built 3D porosity/throats, scaffold-scale compression/fatigue/permeability, degradation/leachables, surface-treatment depth/aging, mechanistic factorial interactions, mineralization/matrix, vascularized animal bone repair, and manufacturing reproducibility.
proxy_to_outcome_bridges: Polymer-sheet tensile modulus is not scaffold effective modulus or load-bearing capacity.
ALP per DNA under osteogenic induction is an early differentiation signal, not osteoinduction, mineralization, or bone formation.
Resazurin is metabolic activity, not direct cell number/viability alone.
Cell presence inside a fiber shows penetration, not vascularized tissue integration.
Literature pore-size thresholds do not validate vascularization in this construct.
overclaim_risks: The abstract says the stiffest acrylic-acid-treated scaffold promoted osteogenesis more strongly, although the direct endpoint is day-15 ALP in induction medium (S001:C01; S022:C01).
Statements about load-bearing defects or large-defect filling exceed scaffold-scale mechanical and in-vivo evidence (S023:C01; S024:C01).
The automatic animal cue is false; all biological evidence is in vitro.

section_moves.move: Separate material variables from architecture variables
section_moves.execution: Monomer ratio and internal-phase fraction tune the PolyHIPE material/microporosity, while microstereolithography defines the woodpile macroarchitecture (S002:C01-S004:C01; S008:C01-S008:C02).
section_moves.transferable_principle: Report chemistry, microstructure, macroarchitecture, surface treatment, and process tuning as separate design axes before claiming independent control.
section_moves.failure_mode: Composition-specific process adjustment can re-couple supposedly independent axes.

section_moves.move: Build a property map before selecting scaffold candidates
section_moves.execution: The authors screen twenty compositions and show modulus, strength, ductility, openness, and wet-state behavior before selecting three P80 materials (S017:C01-S018:C01).
section_moves.transferable_principle: For multi-variable scaffold materials, publish the full design-space map and selection tradeoff rather than only the chosen formulation.
section_moves.failure_mode: Material-level maps must not be relabeled as structural scaffold performance.

section_moves.execution: Only the stiffest material combined with acrylic-acid plasma increased ALP above all other conditions; neither factor alone produced a general effect (S022:C01; S023:C08-S023:C10).
section_moves.transferable_principle: When mechanics, chemistry, and medium interact, write the exact combination and control contrasts; do not assign the outcome to one factor without an interaction test.
section_moves.failure_mode: An ALP interaction under dexamethasone is not proof of stiffness-driven osteogenesis.

section_moves.move: Distinguish demonstrated hierarchical morphology from proposed functional roles
section_moves.execution: The discussion connects micro- and macro-pores to cell attachment, diffusion, bone deposition, and vascularization while acknowledging literature-based rather than direct evidence (S023:C04-S023:C08).
section_moves.transferable_principle: For each pore scale, state measured geometry, directly measured function, literature-supported hypothesis, and missing discriminating experiment.
section_moves.failure_mode: Pore dimensions alone do not prove transport, vessels, or tissue formation.

author_reported: Single-photon resolution limits fiber spacing; two-photon would improve resolution at a throughput cost, and alternative absorbers are proposed (S023:C03).
Mechanisms behind the stiffness-surface ALP interaction remain uncertain and literature on acrylic acid is conflicting (S023:C09-S023:C10).
reader_identified: No scaffold-level compression, fatigue, permeability, degradation, or shape-retention testing.
Nominal porosity and sparse 2D SEM openness do not establish full as-built 3D architecture.
Composition-specific manufacturing tuning and surface treatments introduce coupled variables.
Cell assays have limited independent replication (two biological runs for ALP/PicoGreen), outlier removal, and multiple comparisons.
Selected imaging of high-proliferation samples and absence of nonporous-strut controls weaken causal pore claims.
No late osteogenic markers, mineralized matrix, primary adult MSC comparison, degradation toxicity, animal bone defect, or vascularization.
No animal or clinical evidence despite automatic metadata cues.
likely_bias_direction: Selection of favorable imaging fields/scaffolds may overstate uniform penetration.
Early ALP and literature pore thresholds likely inflate bone-regeneration/vascularization claims.
Material tensile data may be misread as device-level load-bearing performance.
limitations.scope_boundary: The work establishes tunable PolyHIPE material mechanics, hierarchical scaffold fabrication, and short-term in-vitro cell/ALP signals; it does not establish structural load bearing, transport, degradation, vascularization, bone regeneration, or clinical utility.

writing_capability_candidates.capability: Separate scaffold chemistry, strut material properties, microstructure, macroarchitecture, surface state, and manufacturing calibration before relating design to function.
writing_capability_candidates.manuscript_use: Methods design table, Results property map, and causal Discussion.
writing_capability_candidates.counterexample_or_boundary: Polymer-sheet tensile properties and nominal porosity are not the effective properties of the final scaffold.

writing_capability_candidates.capability: Write multiscale pore-function claims as measured geometry, direct functional evidence, literature hypothesis, and missing validation for each scale.
writing_capability_candidates.counterexample_or_boundary: Pore size and cell penetration do not demonstrate vascularization or continuous bone tissue formation.

writing_capability_candidates.capability: Report mechanics-chemistry-medium interactions without attributing a biological effect to one design variable.
writing_capability_candidates.manuscript_use: Factorial Results, mechanobiology Discussion, and conclusion audit.
writing_capability_candidates.counterexample_or_boundary: A day-15 ALP increase under induction medium supports an interaction signal, not stiffness-driven osteogenesis or in-vivo bone formation.

critical_weaknesses: Material-sheet mechanics substitute for final scaffold mechanics.
Sparse as-built morphology and no nonporous-strut or established scaffold comparator.
Early in-vitro markers and no degradation/animal validation.

summary_zh: 这篇研究先用 5 种 EHA/IBOA 比例×4 个名义孔隙率建立 20 种 PolyHIPE 材料的拉伸模量、强度、延性和开放度图谱，再选择 3 种 P80 材料打印四层木堆支架并做表面等离子体处理与体外细胞实验。最重要的边界是尺度：薄片拉伸性质描述的是聚合物/支杆材料，不是最终支架的压缩、疲劳或承载性能；名义孔隙率和少量二维 SEM 也不是完整 as-built 三维孔网络。只有‘最硬材料+丙烯酸表面’在含地塞米松培养基中提高 day-15 ALP，说明是力学—化学—培养条件交互信号，不能归因于刚度或写成骨形成。Skill 将据此把化学、支杆材料、微孔、宏观结构、表面状态和工艺校准分栏，并要求每个孔尺度分别写 measured geometry、direct function、literature hypothesis 与 missing validation。
reader_notes: Primary Codex reader reviewed every non-reference packet section, including the 20-composition screen, fabrication process, all cell assays, imaging selection, and ten-part Discussion.
The automatic animal cue is incorrect; the biological work is entirely in vitro.
The paper is a strong multi-axis material-selection exemplar and a useful scale-mismatch counterexample.
